hook_text: Every morning, thousands of feet make a path that no one ever built.
clip_script: Khayelitsha, seven in the morning. Sipho takes a short cut across the field on a footpath made by feet, not machines. Then the street, full of people walking to the taxi rank. Then the main road, with taxis and buses. And beyond it the N2 highway, carrying trucks to the city and the harbour. Footpaths for walking. Streets for getting around the settlement. Roads and highways to join settlements together. And at every crossing: look right, look left, look right again.
visual_style: Whiteboard map growing outwards from one footpath to a street, a main road and finally a highway, with arrows showing people and vehicles moving.
mood: Busy and cheerful, like the morning rush.
pacing: From the smallest path to the biggest road, then a quick road safety rule.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and trace the paths and roads you use on your way to school.
